value.rationale: Connects the global numerical index to Banach--Mazur Hilbert distortion by a sharp dimension-free modulus, including infinite-dimensional spaces. Equality on an infinite sequence of polygonal norms approaching Hilbert geometry proves that the square-root sensitivity, unlike merely qualitative continuity, is structurally optimal. Numerical index of those polygons alone is preexisting and not sold as novelty.
